events.title: Dev Update: How We Animate 2D Anomalies in Kritsana
events.summary: Hey everyone! Today, we wanted to share a quick look at how we turn static 2D anomaly art into something that moves and creeps you out in Kritsana.Once the base illustration is done, the process breaks down into three main steps:Step 1: Cutting up the spriteFirst, we slice the artwork into separate pieces: head, torso, arms, legs, and so on.
